title: JVC Music Play
meta_description: JVC Music Play is the app to listen to music from your Android device.
full_description: ■ What is JVC Music Play?JVC  Music Play is the app to listen to music from your Android device (Android OS 4.1 to 7.x) with the JVC  car-audio receiver connected via USB. 　■ FeatureEven if the Android device of OS 4.1 to 7.x does not support USB Mass Storage Class, you can enjoy the music with JVC car-audio receiver. Play or search for music with the JVC car-audio receiver, and check the playing music’s information on your Android device. 　■ Check here for the supported Android devices, JVC car-audio receivers, and FAQ.JVC Music Play → http://www.jvc.net/car/app/jmp/index.html 　■ CautionWe do not guarantee correct operation for all devices. Some Android device may freeze if the device is unconnected without pressing the Disconnect button.
